precision.allocation_note: Budget baseline precision slots include pitch/MULT/SH input paths where specified. Additional protected-input count is a conservative cv-role reserve; #33 must remap each actual cell to its true role and board package rather than treating the rough count split as a netlist.

island_contract.constraint: Every component/panel UID/local net in an island must share one physical board. Partition verifier rejects any local net crossing.

remote_controls.fixed_geometry: No panel control or jack coordinates change. Signals needing local timing stay on circuit board; RANGE changes buffered CV or local switch command.

calibration.assembly: Factory-only soldering and socket population; factory adjustment through accessible test points.
calibration.pitch_tracking_scope: 0..5 V at 25 C after factory calibration; target only, not guaranteed by resistor tolerance. #29 defines sweep and temperature characterization.
calibration.sample_hold: No long-hold pitch accuracy promise; characterize droop separately from output load error.
calibration.pitch_voltage_error_caveat: 5 cents at 1 V/oct equals 4.166667 mV; oscillator exponential/core error and temperature must share this total budget. A 2 mV octave-step target alone does not prove five-octave tracking.

capacitance.startup_status: NEEDS BENCH; legacy supply startup unresolved

connections: One channel per input jack; source S always faces patch cable; drain D always faces local circuit.
Unused source/drain grounded, unused IN grounded, FF explicitly no-connect.
notes: Powered-off isolation replaces a naked rail-clamp path. GND must stay connected with patch sleeves. No ±55 V system rating is inferred; project fault range is ±12 V.
Fault switch uses ±12 V rails; ±15 V datasheet tables are planning references, not guaranteed ±12 V performance. Drain clamps/current limiting below remain mandatory.
Do not tie enable directly to +12 V. Require #24 power-sequence analysis for missing-rail and ground-loss cases.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: JACK -> input_fault_switch -> PROTECTED.
Precision pitch/MULT/SH input selects precision role; audio input selects audio role.
notes: 100 kohm nominal at drain; switch on resistance adds series error. No independent 10 kohm pot may load the jack.
Clamp leakage and input current, especially hot, remain part of the input error budget.
Nominal accuracy limited to ±5 V; ±12 V is a continuous survival requirement, not a linear input range.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: JACK -> input_fault_switch -> PROTECTED -> R_IN -> virtual ground SUM.
Parent summer provides feedback resistor 100 kohm per unity input and 10 pF C0G in parallel; amplifier role audio or cv by parent.
notes: The input resistor limits current, and the upstream fault switch isolates an unpowered circuit. Bare 100 kohm resistance alone is not power-off isolation.
Do not also add a 100 kohm pulldown at PROTECTED on this variant: it would halve input impedance.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: Local feedback before the resistor. For DC/gates select cv role.
notes: 998 ohm gives 0.990119 gain into 100 kohm; nominal ±5 V specified unloaded.
Each project-output pair at opposite ±12 V has 12.024 mA maximum ideal current and 0.0722 W per 499 ohm resistor. Ground short at 12 V is also 0.0722 W per 499 ohm resistor.
No simultaneous-all-output-short supply claim. Test sustained one-channel short and paired outputs per IC, including junction temperature.

Two series 499 ohm / 0.5 W resistors realize 998 ohm nominal. A continuous external ±12 V fault against the opposite output rail gives 24.05 mA and 0.289 W per resistor at nominal rails; qualify IC thermal dissipation.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: DC feedback senses JACK through 100 ohm R_FB; 1 nF high-frequency feedback returns locally from DRIVE to FB.
notes: Fixed 100 ohm JACK feedback and 1 nF local feedback are TI OPAx197 model-screened compensation choices, not hardware stability proof. Value-specific resistor and capacitor orderable identities remain unresolved.
DC load-induced error target <=1 mV for -5/0/+5 V, no load to 10 kohm; full static path error target <=2 mV after factory calibration.

TI-model sweep: open/10k/100k loads and 0/100p/1n/5n F cable loads, +/-5 V steps; require no sustained oscillation, <=10% overshoot and settle within 1 mV by 1 ms. Physical cable, PCB parasitics, component tolerances and temperature require qualification.
Feedback stays on the jack board with output cell; no long unsensed feedback net across connectors.

Two series 499 ohm / 0.5 W resistors realize 998 ohm nominal. A continuous external ±12 V fault against the opposite output rail gives 24.05 mA and 0.289 W per resistor at nominal rails; qualify IC thermal dissipation.
verification: TI OPAx197 Final 1.3 model sweep in #49; physical cable and layout stability remain NOT RUN.

connections: Feedback sensed locally after isolation; remote destination high impedance except the assigned 10 kohm pot.
notes: Internal harness only, never an exposed jack output. Cable <=300 mm and <=1 nF design envelope; qualify actual harness.
CV/reference drives may use cv role; no shared driver exceeding 2 mA DC load.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: JACK -> high_impedance_input -> BUFFERED_INPUT -> remote_buffer -> REMOTE_INPUT.
Vout = 2*Vwiper - Vbuffered_input. CW is positive, CCW negative; swap only terminal assignment after mechanical audit.
notes: 47 pots retain 10 kohm. Buffered source avoids the former 10 kohm jack load. Wiper failure tends toward negative endpoint; not safety zero.
10 Mohm fail resistor slightly curves law; endpoint/centre gain tolerance target 0.5%, centre trim is by knob setting.
For CV-only instance use cv role; precision AO uses precision role.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: Bipolar endpoints -5/+5 V; unipolar endpoints AGND/+5 V. Module maps normalized 0..1 or -1..1 to named function using explicit gain.
notes: 48 pots become 100 kohm B104 in unchanged mechanical family. 0.1 mA each across ±5 V; total 4.8 mA on each analog rail.
At most six pots per pair of local reference buffers; Kelvin reference return accompanies harness.
10 nF wiper filter gives variable time constant up to approximately 0.26 ms. Do not use for audio.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: Buffered module audio -> remote_buffer -> REMOTE_INPUT; output feeds general_output.
notes: 4 pots retain 10 kohm; nominal gain 0..1. MIX4 SUM GAIN remains a DC-source role, not an audio level pot.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: REF_5V = +5 V, REF_N5V = -5 V, GATE_REF = 5*100/122 V.
Distribute through local remote_buffer cells; REF5050 does not source all pots.
No physical ±10 V reference: clip compares buffered node/2 against ±5 V.
notes: 1 uF capacitor uses X7R value variant of c_bypass series, with effective C checked against manufacturer stability guidance in #15.
REF5050 trim left open; factory adjusts octave scaling downstream. Use 100 nF local bypass on each amplifier rail in addition to explicit caps.
Raw reference buffers and local fan-out are separate allocations. Buffered ±5 V fan-out pairs use cv role and serve at most six 100 kohm pots per pair.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: T0 is BOTTOM (-2 V), T5 is TOP (adjustable around +3 V); T1..T4 are local ladder nodes.
Each tap is buffered before the six-position panel selector; selected wiper returns into a precision buffer with 10 Mohm pulldown.
notes: Shared ladder on one local reference island; only buffered tap voltages cross harness.
Five resistors at 0.1% cannot guarantee 1 mV octave accuracy. Factory measure every step; accept <=2 mV deviation per step after span adjustment or change resistor matching under #29.
R_FIXED 19.1 kohm + 1 kohm trim gives gain 2.91..3.01; nominal +3 V is reachable. Lower endpoint error is measured, not silently trimmed away.

R_ONE_TOP is two 20 kohm 0.1% series resistors; T0..T5 buffers plus ONE/TOPDRV/BOTDRV total nine precision sections. Budget reserves 16 sections for master references, this cell and selected-wiper receiver sharing; the per-module baseline also includes pitch paths.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: JACK -> high_impedance_input -> BUFFERED.
Comparator runs from +12 V/GND, not ±12 V: its open collector low must be 0 V for HC logic.
Biased divider keeps comparator input positive for bipolar jack signals. GATE_HIGH rises with the jack.
notes: Ideal thresholds including 4.7 kohm pull-up are calculated by check_standard.py (about 1.47 V rising, 0.97 V falling); comparator offset, VOL and rail/reference tolerances widen them.
Acceptance windows rising 1.35..1.65 V, falling 0.85..1.15 V. Trigger semantics are rising edge, not sustained gate.
Module uses CD74HC221M96 for SH acquisition; do not interpret button contact bounce as repeated sample events.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: LED lies on DC diagonal of a four-diode bridge; DRIVE and SENSE are AC corners.
Feedback forces SENSE approximately equal MONITOR; LED current = abs(MONITOR)/5600.
notes: One amplifier per indicator, 92 sites. About 0.893 mA at ±5 V. LED is isolated from signal source by high-impedance amplifier input.
At larger magnitudes amplifier clips: brightness may saturate and is not a calibrated voltmeter. At audio rates the eye averages rectified current. No polarity or plug detection.
Only already buffered nodes may feed MONITOR. Hold/timing/integrator/storage nodes are forbidden.
Driver stays with LED on its board; only buffered MONITOR plus adjacent analog return cross a connector.

At assumed ±13.2 V rail extremes and 1% minimum 5.6 kohm sense resistor, the ideal zero-diode-drop branch bound is 4.762 mA, below the approximate 5 mA white-LED current derating at 85 C. Exact resistor tolerance/sourcing, loop faults and hot LED ambient remain unqualified.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: Comparators wired-OR to CLIP_N; negative rail is the low level. This output is analog LED drive only and must not touch 5 V logic.
notes: 10 sites; trip at nominal ±10 V on internal pre-attenuation node. About 1 mA LED current when CLIP_N approaches -12 V.
No hysteresis or hold capacitor fitted: intentional immediate clip indication; threshold flicker is allowed.
Monitor after a dedicated buffer; mixer detector before output level/VCA, AO detector before output isolation.
Changing op-amp or load requires checking actual headroom against 10 V; threshold remains PROPOSAL.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: NOT_OWN_STAGE is 5 V except while that particular attack or release stage is active.
notes: 12 sites, one amplifier each (planning table counted only six amplifiers; budget corrects it). ENV 8 V -> COMMAND 0.5 V -> 0.5 mA.
Off in idle and sustain. Stage command logic defaults to mute at startup. Monitors buffered ENV, never integrator.

A 1.2 kohm nominal series resistor limits stage white-LED current. At 1% resistor tolerance and assumed +5 V upper bound 5.5 V, zero-V LED/transistor lower bound gives 4.630 mA and 25.46 mW in the resistor, below the exact LED 30 mA DC absolute maximum at 25 C and about 5 mA read conservatively from the manufacturer current derating curve at 85 C. Exact resistor thermal derating, regulated rail upper bound, and installed LED ambient remain qualification gates. At 0.5 mA, resistor drop is 0.6 V; high-VF headroom and low-current light output are unproven.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: Contact shorts CONTACT to AGND. Repeat per toggle throw, each rotary function is voltage selection instead.
notes: Button/toggle carries logic/return only. 1 ms nominal pull-up time is a starting filter; qualify actual bounce in #18/#31.
A/B routes logic to local selection or buffered audio only; never connect two raw jacks through an unprotected switch.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: 100 nF per IC supply pin to local return; +5 V logic gets 100 nF VCC to DGND.
4.7 uF maximum per powered board per rail as starting allocation. R_BLEED appears once per whole instrument rail, not once per IC/board.
notes: Instrument nominal ceilings: 150 uF on each ±12 V rail, 100 uF on +5 V, including ceramic bypass, references, regulators and bulk. Use +20% tolerance for inrush.
No bulk multiplier by module; #24 and #35 must maintain capacitor ledger. No extra 10/47/100 uF per module by habit.
R_BLEED uses 0.125 W minimum for ±12 V (65.5 mW nominal); +5 V dissipates 11.4 mW. Backfeed voltage remains a measured gate.
Small capacitance does not qualify the supply: the 4.5 A/2 ms vs 3 A source startup case remains OPEN.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: 10 kohm adjustment in series with 100 kohm limiting resistor; wiper strapped to an end.
Octave span explicitly uses trim_102 in octave_reference instead.
notes: Factory assembled SMD only, accessible probe/adjustment path after assembly. No owner soldering or cut traces.
Module selects scaling around these fixed values in its spec; no trimmer wired unbounded across rails.
Record serial, warm-up 20 min, rails, ambient, meter, setting and every measured endpoint; repeat pitch checks over intended temperature.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

connections: PRE_OUT -> 2.2 kohm -> 0..500 kohm rheostat -> STORAGE; five 100 nF C0G to ground.
SLEW_OUT -> precision_output; no direct storage-node indicator or connector.
notes: Pot UID, RC bank, pre/post amplifiers form one declared board island. LF398 and 10 nF hold cap form a separate local core island.
Nominal tau 1.1..251.1 ms; no true bypass, linear ramp or 25-second claim.
Separate output amplifier is conservatively reserved; #22 may fold POST into precision_output only with explicit equivalent feedback/stability validation.
verification: Capture/ERC and ideal/vendor simulation in #18; physical validation remains open.

release_gates: Power-off and missing-rail input injection, all 98 inputs and single-channel ±12 V faults, with GND connected. Record drain leakage, rail lift, latch-up, recovery and temperature; no zero-backfeed assertion.
Output short/output-output patch thermal test; two 499 ohm / 0.5 W resistors provide 1 W total nominal isolation resistance rating; derating and IC temperature remain unqualified.
Compensated output and harness stability across 0..5 nF loads.
Magnitude LED headroom/visual visibility, stage shutoff, clip threshold under load.
Exact-part sources, pin maps, availability and factory assembly acceptance.
Actual netlist current/capacitance ledger in #33/#34; startup and physical bench qualification still open.

defaults_disposition.decision: ±5 V nominal; ±12 V continuous survival, not linear operation
1.000 V/oct, 0.1% resistors and factory calibration; ratio tolerance alone does not guarantee tracking
0/5 V nominal through buffered general output
Approximately 1.5/1.0 V; biased divider and actual pullup included in calculation
100 kohm nominal including protected, buffered attenuverters
Nominal 1 kohm external feedback isolation, realized as 2 x 499 ohm / 0.5 W

998 ohm inside compensated feedback limits fault current. The initial 10 kohm / 100 pF feedback was superseded by #49: current draft uses 100 ohm jack feedback and 1 nF local feedback. Model screening is not hardware qualification.
ADG5412F source isolation plus current limit/clamp. Bare rail clamp can backfeed an unpowered supply
5 V / 5.6 kohm = 0.893 mA nominal; buffer/bridge current drive, with conservative hot-current screen pending physical validation
±10 V at pre-attenuation internal node via divide-by-two window
960/640/400 mA. Preliminary negative rail exceeds ceiling; #34 must reduce current before partition

r_power.realization: Two 499 ohm parts in series per exposed output

passive_policy.meaning: These are project selection targets, not verified ratings of an unretained exact variant. #15/#21 must match every fitted value and rating to its own complete MPN; no substitution of dielectric on storage nodes.

supply_architecture.source_status: External regulated requirement contract only; physical source and inlet NOT SELECTED
supply_architecture.rationale: Original single-source and two-source planning totals fail. Three sources fit a conditional allocation/reserved rear volume but do not establish voltage-loss or exact inlet/cable interface. #48 selects a requirement contract; original capacity comparisons remain visible.
supply_architecture.capacitance_policy: Unchanged 150/150/100 uF nominal +20%; selected source must ramp no faster than 10 ms and meet full-capacitance transient requirement. #52 counts fitted direct-rail decouplers as 48.3/41.1/24.5 uF; #54/#35 must allocate the still-unplaced initial 4.7 uF per powered board/rail.
supply_architecture.captured_interface: OSC-EXT-PWR-8-R1 logical pins and an abstract, non-orderable, non-energizable EXT boundary; raw inlet nets remain distinct from conditional load rails. No protection circuit is implemented.
